name: Claude Memory Tool
summary: Client-side Claude API tool that lets Claude create, read, update and delete files in a /memories directory to persist knowledge across conversations.
description: Tool type `memory_20250818`. Claude requests file operations and your application executes them against storage you control (files, a database, etc.). Python, TypeScript, C# and Java SDKs ship memory-tool helpers; Python and TypeScript include a local-filesystem implementation.
